_comment: A built force pair of unequal size (v2 Phase 2): `npm run play -- --forces built:data/forces/mixed-12-vs-24.json`. p1 is 12 health, mixed, and names everything setup would otherwise draw -- its Home, its Frontier proposal and its one dragon -- so it consumes no draw at all. p2 is a 24-health Treefolk force with everything drawn. Each force reads its own size: one dragon each (24 is still 'one per 24'), and p2's armies may each hold up to 12. The engine allows the mismatch; the start screen is what calls an unequal pairing a mistake. src/engine/built.test.ts sets it up.
